boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 57 stacks two purple boss chambers — '5' on top, '11' on the bottom — with three white '10' blocks at the very base. The chambers share a wall, so clearing one affects the other. Start with the bottom '10' blocks, then work both chambers in parallel, letting the smaller '5' chamber clear faster while the '11' chamber gradually opens.
landmarks: Block Out Level 57 stacks two purple boss chambers — '5' on top, '11' on the bottom — with three white '10' blocks at the very base.
The chambers share a wall, so clearing one affects the other.
Start with the bottom '10' blocks, then work both chambers in parallel, letting the smaller '5' chamber clear faster while the '11' chamber gradually opens.

quickTips: The two chambers share a wall — do not fully drain the '5' before the '11' has made progress.
Start with the bottom '10' blocks. They are independent targets that open the base.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the three white '10' blocks at the bottom by sliding them toward the right exit.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Shift the yellow blocks on the left out through the left exit to open the gap between the two chambers.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Begin draining the upper '5' chamber — it is smaller and clears faster, opening space above.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Work the lower '11' chamber in parallel, sliding its blocks out through the right exit.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: As the '5' chamber empties, use the freed space to help the '11' chamber blocks slide out.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the remaining green and blue blocks trapped between the emptied chambers.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the red and purple blocks at the top and sides.

failurePoints: Fully draining the '5' chamber before the '11' has made progress — the shared wall provides sliding support for both, and losing it too early traps blocks.
Ignoring the bottom '10' blocks and trying to work the chambers first, which leaves the base packed and blocks can't slide down.
